mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `position` (activity_id, name, description, quota, required_hours) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{quota}, #{requiredHours})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `position` WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.activity_id, p.name, p.description, p.quota, p.assigned_count, p.required_hours, p.created_at, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR '，') AS requirements FROM `position` p LEFT JOIN position_tag pt ON pt.position_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.activity_id = #{activityId} AND p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.activity_id, p.name, p.description, p.quota, p.assigned_count, p.required_hours, p.created_at ORDER BY p.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE `position` SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, quota = #{quota}, required_hours = #{requiredHours}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE `position` SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tag WHERE name = #{name} AND category = #{category} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tag (name, category) VALUES (#{name}, #{category})
INSERT IGNORE INTO position_tag (position_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{positionId}, #{tagId})
